title: Initial-horn cylinder pushout of a marked mapping simplex
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, simplices, horns and degreewise products of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the marked mapping simplex of [lem-coef-cartesian-mapping-simplex-presentation], and marked products and minimal markings of [lem-coef-marked-point-cartesian-model]. Let $n\geq1$ and let $A_0\leftarrow\cdots\leftarrow A_n$ be a chain of small simplicial sets, with transition maps $t_{j,i}:A_j\to A_i$ for $i\leq j$. Put $M=M^m(A)$, whose $r$-simplices are $(\alpha,a)$ with $\alpha:[r]\to[n]$ monotone and $a\in(A_{\alpha(r)})_r$, and put $K=\Lambda_0^n$ and $M_K=M\times_{\Delta^n}K$. Let $T_n$ consist of all degenerate edges of $\Delta^n$ and the edge $[0,1]$. Give $M$ the marking in which $(\alpha,a)$ is marked exactly when $\alpha\in T_n$ and $a$ is degenerate, and give $M_K$ the induced marking. Write $K^T=(K,T_n\cap K_1)$ and $D^T=(\Delta^n,T_n)$. The formula
$$c:A_n^\flat\times D^T\longrightarrow M,\qquad (a,\alpha)\longmapsto(\alpha,t_{n,\alpha(r)}(a))$$
defines a marked simplicial map. It restricts to $c_K:A_n^\flat\times K^T\to M_K$, and $c_K$ and the product inclusion exhibit $M$ as the pushout of the span
$$M_K\xleftarrow{c_K}A_n^\flat\times K^T\longrightarrow A_n^\flat\times D^T,$$
with structure maps the inclusion $M_K\to M$ and $c$. Explicitly, this is a pushout in marked simplicial sets: for every marked simplicial set $Z$, compatible marked maps from $M_K$ and $A_n^\flat\times D^T$ to $Z$ extend uniquely to a marked map $M\to Z$. This includes $n=1$, where $K=\{0\}$ and $M_K=A_0^\flat$, and allows empty terms of the chain.
